$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: Unique merchant id, e.g. "briar-glen-general-store". Stable once shipped.

notes.description: Who runs it and why these prices and stock, for owner review.

npcId.description: The NPC who speaks for the shop (dialogue speaker id).

displayName.description: The keeper’s name as the shop window shows it, e.g. "Ottilie Marsh"; absent = the NPC id made readable.

shopName.description: The shop’s name, e.g. "Brand’s Forge" (signage, shop window subtitle).

personalityTags.description: Personality traits that colour barks and haggling.

specialties.description: Item categories bought at a better rate (`specialtyBonus`); must be bought categories.

buysCategories.description: Item categories the merchant buys from the player.

lootTable.description: A loot table rolled to stock the shelf (a shop that varies).

count.description: Units of the item, or rolls of the loot table.

restock.description: How the stock refills; absent = never restocks (a unique good never returns once sold). Runs on world-day ticks: `amount` every `everyHours` rounded up to whole days, up to `count`. A loot-table entry with a rule rotates instead: its unsold units are replaced by `count` fresh rolls each period.

amount.description: Units (or rolls) added each time, up to `count`.

when.description: A world-fact condition (mw-e27.5): the entry is absent until it holds, appears at the next restock and stays.

services.description: Services on the shop window’s Services tab (an inn’s rooms).

id.description: Service id, unique within the merchant, e.g. "room-for-the-night".

name.description: What the shop window lists, e.g. "Room for the night".

price.description: Crowns, fixed by the merchant: no markup, disposition or haggle applies. A `rest` service sits in the inn-bed band 8-15.

kind.description: `rest`: sleep until morning, fully healed (the Sleeping Ox room).

goldReserve.description: Gold the merchant starts with to pay the player for sales.

goldRestockPerDay.description: Gold the reserve refills by each in-world day, up to `goldReserve`.

markup.description: Multiplier on item value when the player buys (economy band 1.1-1.5).

buyRate.description: Fraction of item value paid when the player sells (band 0.3-0.6).

specialtyBonus.description: Extra multiplier on the buy rate for specialties (band 1.1-1.3); default 1.2.

isFence.description: A fence deals in stolen goods.

buysStolen.description: Buys stolen goods; only a fence (`isFence`) may.

stolenFactor.description: Multiplier on the price of stolen goods (band 0.5-0.8); default 0.6.

hours.description: Opening hours (world-time hook); absent = always open.

open.description: Hour of day (0-23) the shop opens.

close.description: Hour of day (0-23) it closes; may be earlier than open (overnight).

barkSet.description: Bark set id for the shopkeeper’s lines (E22).

condition.description: A condition over world facts: one of fact, count, all, any, not (docs/design/conditions.md).

fact.description: Fact key to test. Alone: the (bool) fact is true. With one operator: that comparison holds.

neq.description: The fact does not equal this value (unset counts as unequal).

gt.description: The (int or tick) fact is greater than this.

gte.description: The (int or tick) fact is at least this.

lt.description: The (int or tick) fact is less than this.

lte.description: The (int or tick) fact is at most this.

has.description: true: the fact holds a value (set, or declared with a non-null default); false: none.

anyOf.description: Tests one fact, with at most one operator.

count.description: Entity facts to count: `entity:<level>/*.<fact>` (one level) or `entity:*/*.<fact>` (every level). Counts those holding true.

neq.description: The count does not equal this.

gt.description: The count is greater than this.

gte.description: The count is at least this.

lt.description: The count is less than this.

lte.description: The count is at most this.

anyOf.description: Counts true entity facts matching a pattern, compared with exactly one operator.
True when every condition in the list holds.
True when at least one condition in the list holds.

not.description: The condition that must not hold.

anyOf.description: True when the condition does not hold.
